lines.text: And so, we officially form our very own photography club.

lines.speaker: amy
lines.text: Ah, is this the new park that just opened?

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Yeah. The flowers are in full bloom right now, so it's supposed to be really pretty.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: I already packed us lunch, so we can go right now.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Of course we'll take them while we're there! We're killing two birds with one stone.
Arcana hands me back the camera.
In the photo, she's sitting by the cafe window, gazing outside with a wistful look in her eyes.
You don't usually make that kind of expression.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: That's because I'm a student right now!

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Normally I'm a cold, ruthless professional! An ice queen, just so you know!
You should've done it earlier instead of putting it off.

lines.speaker: amy
lines.text: You're gonna say you're having too much fun at school, aren't you?

lines.speaker: amy
lines.text: You must have said that ten times already.
I feed the pouting Arcana some chocolate,
That's why I'm helping you. Let's finish up quickly.
For something that's supposed to be a photography club, it feels more like we're just enjoying school life...
Arcana aims her camera at me and presses the shutter. Her eyes widen when she looks at the screen.
Arcana playfully hides the camera behind her back.

lines.speaker: amy
lines.text: Um... it's better if you didn't see it, {AccountData.NickName}.

lines.speaker: amy
lines.text: Just like in paintings, they say a photographer's emotions and perspective...

lines.speaker: amy
lines.text: They're captured in the photos they take.

lines.speaker: amy
lines.text: And it's abundantly clear this one is filled with affect—mmph!

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: S-speaking of which, why don't we go on photo-taking trip?
After breaking free from Arcana, Amy scans the tasks.

lines.speaker: amy
lines.text: Well, since it's getting a bit late today...

lines.speaker: amy
lines.text: Why don't we take some photos around the school?

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: The cherry blossoms on campus will make for a great background!

lines.speaker: amy
lines.text: I'll take a photo for you.
Arcana steps in front of me and leans her back against my chest.
You always do this when we take pictures together.

lines.speaker: amy
lines.text: {AccountData.NickName}, don't stand there like a statue. Move closer to her.
I lean forward slightly, hugging Arcana and resting my head on her shoulder.
Arcana stiffens for a moment, then looks up at me and grins.
Amy's turning into a real professional photographer.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Yeah. She's way more into it than I expected.

lines.speaker: amy
lines.text: That's it, keep talking while looking at each other like that!
She's telling us to keep talking?

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Uh... what should we talk about?
What should we eat for dinner?

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: What do you want to eat?

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Pfft, what kind of an answer is that?

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Then let's have pasta. I'll make it.

lines.speaker: amy
lines.text: What were you two talking about? Arcana was looking at you with such lovey-dovey eyes.
Nothing special. We were just talking about what to eat for dinner.
I'm imitating the pose you always do for selfies.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Huh? When have I ever done that?
Arcana starts striking a strange pose.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: You've gotta do it like this.

lines.speaker: amy
lines.text: ... Could you two be serious for a second?
After continuing the shoot for a while...

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Let's take a picture of the three of us.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: A proper one. Something we can treasure forever.

lines.speaker: amy
lines.text: I-I don't really like being photographed...
Arcana links an arm with Amy and pulls her over.
Then she links arms with me on her other side.
How are you even going to take the photo like this?
Arcana quickly sets the camera on a tripod and hurries back.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: I don't even need to look at Amy to know what her expression is.
I feel the same way, Amy.

lines.speaker: amy
lines.text: I get bright, but what does youthful even mean?
The camera light flashes, signaling the photo is about to be taken.
At that moment, Arcana pokes Amy in the side.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Of course it does—I'm tickling you on purpose.
Arcana's fingers suddenly dig into my side when I'm not paying attention.
After Amy leaves first, Arcana and I take a short walk around the campus before sitting on a bench.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: We should take photos at school more often.
Yeah, they turned out pretty well.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Right? The school is so pretty and it has such a youthful vibe.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: I'm not the only one having fun, right?

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: You weren't uncomfortable being around Amy, were you?
Did it look like I was?

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: I just want to hear you say it.
Seeing you enjoy yourself makes me happy too.
swinging her legs as she sits on the bench.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: So, as long as I'm happy, you're happy, right?

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Very, very happy. I feel amazing!
Somehow I've gotten used to her calling my name.
Arcana leans against my shoulder in what's now a familiar motion.
Arcana lifts her head and looks up at me.
Her face contains an expression unlike any I've seen before.
It's a mixture of various emotions:

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: ... For being a part of my dream.
seems to melt into the spring breeze.
